proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation — block_travel variant
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's core mechanic is a barrier that prevents creatures from passing through it. This is a block_travel effect (v4 atom), but OngoingOperation only supports roll_modifier and damage_on_hit. A new variant such as { kind: 'block_travel'; creatureTypeExemptions?: ReadonlyArray<CreatureType> } is required.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The aura prevents creatures other than Constructs and Undead from passing or reaching through it.

proposed_widenings.name: AreaOrigin — self_centered (emanation) origin
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's area originates from the caster and moves with them. This is an 'emanation' in SRD 5.2.1 terminology. AreaOrigin currently only models point_within_range and on_primary_target; neither captures a caster-anchored sphere.
proposed_widenings.evidence: An aura extends from you in a 10-foot Emanation for the duration.

proposed_widenings.name: CreatureTypeFilter on OngoingOperation
proposed_widenings.justification: The blocking effect applies to all creature types except Constructs and Undead. No current surface type carries a creature-type exemption predicate. This is a closed enum filter needed on the block_travel operation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The aura prevents creatures other than Constructs and Undead from passing or reaching through it.

proposed_widenings.name: Duration — self_break_on_caster_movement condition
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell has a special termination rule: it ends if the caster moves into an affected creature. This is not instantaneous, concentration-upTo, or timed. A new variant or an additional optional field on concentration duration is needed to express caster-movement-triggered self_break.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you move so that an affected creature is forced to pass through the barrier, the spell ends.

notes: Family is unambiguously ongoing_effect (concentration, caster-centered, persistent). All four gaps are variants of existing surface types; all required v4 atoms exist (block_travel, self_break, area, self). No atom_widening or structural_widening is forced. The critical blocker is OngoingOperation having no block_travel variant.
